gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta is a plain sans with a dominant x-height and terminals cut back to leave big gaps. Noto Sans Tirhuta keeps text clean, while Gugi, with tall lowercase and open terminals, delivers the bold display punch.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Chalky, open, and a bit cheeky. Noto Sans Ugaritic leaves its letter mouths unjoined and keeps lowercase close to cap height, while Gugi handles the bold, distinctive display work.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-stack-sans-headline: Goldman spreads its wide, generous letters out with a big lowercase and round forms like open parentheses. Stack Sans Headline works best at small sizes, with crisp gaps.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-stack-sans-notch: Chunky, open and friendly. Stack Sans Notch has rod-stock strokes with open curves, and Grandstander, with its tall x-height and short ascenders, brings the expressive display punch.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-prompt: Tall, open and a bit cheeky, Gugi nearly lifts its lowercase to capital height, with terminals cut open. And Prompt, a plain sans with an oversized look and open apertures, keeps its small letters easy to read.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Noto Sans Phoenician reads modern and generous, with wide-opening s curves and a tall lowercase. Noto Sans Phoenician stays out of the way, while Flavors earns its keep big and short, with towering x-height and heavy diagonals.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-stack-sans-text: Goldman stretches wide with round, parenthesis-like forms. Stack Sans Text, a plain sans, draws a marker-like constant line with well-spaced curve endings and big-bodied lowercase, so paragraphs flow smoothly.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-tiktok-sans: Loud, open and chunky, Grandstander holds its letters wide with a tall x-height and short ascenders. TikTok Sans lifts its x-height close to cap height.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Dark and aggressive, Eater sets wide gaps between letters. Noto Sans Palmyrene lets curves stop short instead of closing, with compressed ascenders that keep text tidy, while Eater does its best work large.
gen-almendra-display-gf-montserrat-alter: Montserrat Alternates reads contemporary, with a wide-open c and chalkboard lowercase. Its strokes keep one weight, so text skims along smoothly, while Almendra Display adds ornate, literary character up top.
